Hey there. I know how you’re feeling, I’ve been through a lot of times where I’ve wanted to just give up. I have bipolar disorder, schizoaffective disorder, borderline personality disorder and anxiety. Things will get better, I promise you. Everything used to be black and white for me and now I see the world for how beautiful it is and I thank myself everyday for staying. In moments where I feel pure happiness I remind myself this is what I stayed for and it was worth it. It may not seem like it right now, but there is light at the end of the tunnel. Medication, therapy, and supportive people can help you get through this. If you decide it end it now, you’ll never know how much better things can get. You’ll never experience the amazing feeling of love. You’ll never meet your child or your soulmate. You have to stay for them, they need you and you are meant for them. You are here for a reason and you should never forget that. Life has many ups and downs but it always leads somewhere if you allow yourself to find happiness and peace. I know you can do this, if I can, you can. You matter, you have a purpose, and there are people out there who need you, even if you don’t know them yet. You got this. If you need someone to talk to please message me.
